description: Given a Prefect flow that syncs Airbyte Cloud (AirbyteConnection.load(...) pointed at api.airbyte.com, trigger_sync_run_and_wait_for_completion), convert it to an Orchestra pipeline YAML task under the AIRBYTE_CLOUD integration, with connection_id carried over verbatim into parameters.connection_id (never onto the connection: field) and API-key credentials represented via a connection: field rather than inline.

evals.prompt: Convert this Prefect flow to an Orchestra pipeline task (see files/airbyte_cloud_single_sync.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live sync, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A single AIRBYTE_CLOUD task running AIRBYTE_CLOUD_JOB, with parameters.connection_id set to 7e2c9f10-4b3a-4d5e-9f1a-2b3c4d5e6f70 (copied verbatim) and parameters.job_type: sync, plus a connection: field representing the Airbyte Cloud block's API-key credentials — the UUID never appears on the connection: field.

assertions.text: connection_id 7e2c9f10-4b3a-4d5e-9f1a-2b3c4d5e6f70 is carried over verbatim into parameters.connection_id
job_type is sync, matching trigger_sync_run_and_wait_for_completion with no reset_cache
The connection_id UUID is set on parameters.connection_id, not on the connection: field — connection: instead holds the Orchestra Airbyte Cloud connection slug for the block's API-key credentials

evals.prompt: Convert this Prefect flow to an Orchestra pipeline task (see files/airbyte_cloud_reset_sync.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live sync, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A single AIRBYTE_CLOUD task running AIRBYTE_CLOUD_JOB, with parameters.connection_id set to b6f1a2c3-8d4e-4f5a-b6c7-d8e9f0a1b2c3 (copied verbatim) and parameters.job_type: reset (from reset_cache=True), plus a connection: field for the block's API-key credentials.

assertions.text: connection_id b6f1a2c3-8d4e-4f5a-b6c7-d8e9f0a1b2c3 is carried over verbatim into parameters.connection_id
reset_cache=True correctly maps to job_type: reset, not sync
No separate polling/sensor task is added — Orchestra's AIRBYTE_CLOUD_JOB already waits for the reset to complete
